s.note: the welcome spread on Miles Bron's island
s.how: Blitz 400g drained chickpeas with 2 tbsp tahini, 1 garlic clove, lemon and ice water until smooth. Mix 250g Greek yoghurt with half a grated cucumber, garlic and salt for tzatziki. Lay both out with 150g kalamata olives, cherry tomatoes and 4 warm pita breads.

Slice 2 blocks halloumi (500g) into thick slices and dry well. Grill or fry in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes a side until golden. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey, scatter with chilli flakes and fresh oregano leaves and serve straight away.

m.how: Cut 800g lamb leg into cubes and marinate 2 hours with the juice of 1 lemon, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano and 3 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning. Serve in 4 warm pitas with 250g Greek yoghurt mixed with grated cucumber, plus tomato and onion.

w.note: something sweet after the big reveal
w.how: Mix 300g chopped walnuts with 1 tsp cinnamon. Layer 12 sheets filo in a 20x30cm tin, brushing each with 150g melted butter in total, scattering walnuts every third sheet. Cut into diamonds and bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Pour over hot syrup of 200g honey, 100g sugar and 125ml water.

d.how: For each glass, shake 2 tsp instant coffee, 2 tsp sugar and 60ml cold water hard in a jar for 30 seconds until thick foam forms. Pour over ice and top with 80ml cold milk. Serve with a straw.
